license_required.quote: A license is required to engage in the practice of occupational therapy, except as specifically provided in Section 58-1-307 or 58-42a-304.

issuing_authority.quote: There is created within the Department of Commerce the Division of Professional Licensing. The division shall administer and enforce all licensing laws of Title 58, Occupations and Professions.
issuing_authority.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 1 - Division of Professional Licensing Act

name.quote: There is created within the Department of Commerce the Division of Professional Licensing.
name.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 1 - Division of Professional Licensing Act

umbrella_agency.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 1 - Division of Professional Licensing Act

degree_required.value: bachelor's or graduate degree in occupational therapy
degree_required.quote: graduate with a bachelor's or graduate degree for the practice of occupational therapy from an education program accredited by the American Occupational Therapy Association's Accreditation Council for Occupational Therapy Education

accrediting_body.value: American Occupational Therapy Association's Accreditation Council for Occupational Therapy Education (ACOTE)
accrediting_body.quote: accredited by the American Occupational Therapy Association's Accreditation Council for Occupational Therapy Education, a predecessor organization, or an equivalent organization as determined by division rule

required.quote: if applying for licensure on or after July 1, 2015, complete a minimum of 24 weeks of supervised fieldwork experience

duration.quote: complete a minimum of 24 weeks of supervised fieldwork experience

kind.quote: complete a minimum of 24 weeks of supervised fieldwork experience

exams.name: National Board for Certification in Occupational Therapy (NBCOT) examination
exams.notes: Examination approved by the division in consultation with the board; another nationally recognized credentialing body may be approved by division rule as an alternative.
exams.quote: pass an examination approved by the division in consultation with the board and administered by the National Board for Certification in Occupational Therapy, or by another nationally recognized credentialing body as approved by division rule

interval_years.quote: The division shall issue each license under this chapter in accordance with a two-year renewal cycle established by division rule.
interval_years.citation: Section 303 - Term of license -- Expiration -- Renewal.

required.quote: As a condition for renewal of a license under this chapter, a licensee shall complete 24 hours of qualified continuing professional education

hours_per_period.quote: a licensee shall complete 24 hours of qualified continuing professional education, in accordance with standards defined by division rule in collaboration with the board, during each two-year licensure cycle.

available.quote: the division may issue a license as an occupational therapist or as an occupational therapy assistant to an applicant who ... meets the requirements of receiving a license by endorsement under Section 58-1-302

requirements.value: License by endorsement available if applicant holds a license in good standing from another state with similar scope of practice and at least one year of experience; criminal background check required; applicants from states with non-substantially-equal requirements must pass the applicable examination.
requirements.quote: meets the requirements of receiving a license by endorsement under Section 58-1-302; or has been licensed in a state, district, or territory of the United States, or in a foreign country, where the education, experience, or examination requirements are not substantially equal to the requirements of this state, if the applicant passes the applicable examination

exists.quote: "Board" means the Board of Occupational Therapy created in Section 58-42a-201.

national_certification.value: National Board for Certification in Occupational Therapy (NBCOT)
national_certification.quote: pass an examination approved by the division in consultation with the board and administered by the National Board for Certification in Occupational Therapy

national_association.value: American Occupational Therapy Association (AOTA) / Accreditation Council for Occupational Therapy Education (ACOTE)
national_association.quote: accredited by the American Occupational Therapy Association's Accreditation Council for Occupational Therapy Education, a predecessor organization, or an equivalent organization as determined by division rule

regulatory_model.quote: A license is required to engage in the practice of occupational therapy, except as specifically provided in Section 58-1-307 or 58-42a-304.

credential_type.quote: The division shall issue to a person who qualifies under this chapter a license in the classification of: (a) occupational therapist; or (b) occupational therapy assistant.

is_mandatory.quote: A license is required to engage in the practice of occupational therapy

title_protection.quote: using the title occupational therapist or occupational therapy assistant unless licensed under this chapter

scope_protection.quote: engaging or offering to engage in the practice of occupational therapy unless licensed under this chapter or exempted from licensure under Section 58-1-307 or 58-42a-304

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted of a crime in any court except for minor offenses.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: being convicted of a crime in any court except for minor offenses

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating a lawful order, rule, or regulation adopted by the division in consultation with the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: violating a lawful order, rule, or regulation adopted by the division in consultation with the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing substandard care as an occupational therapist due to a deliberate or negligent act or failure to act.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: providing substandard care as an occupational therapist due to a deliberate or negligent act or failure to act regardless of whether actual injury to the client is established

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing substandard care as an occupational therapy assistant, including exceeding delegated authority.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: providing substandard care as an occupational therapy assistant, including exceeding the authority to perform components of intervention selected and delegated by the supervising occupational therapist

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly delegating responsibilities to an individual who lacks the knowledge, skills, or abilities to perform them.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: knowingly delegating responsibilities related to the practice of occupational therapy to an individual, including an occupational therapy aide, who does not have the knowledge, skills, or abilities to perform those responsibilities

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to provide appropriate supervision to an occupational therapy assistant or aide.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failing to provide appropriate supervision in accordance with this chapter to an occupational therapy assistant or occupational therapy aide

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing when physical or mental impairment prevents provision of competent services.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: practicing as an occupational therapist or occupational therapy assistant when physical or mental impairment of the occupational therapist or occupational therapy assistant prevents the provision of competent services to clients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having had a license refused, revoked, suspended, or other disciplinary action taken in another state, territory, or country.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: having had an occupational therapist, occupational therapy assistant, or equivalent license or application refused, revoked, suspended, or other disciplinary action taken in another state, United States territory, or country

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in sexual misconduct with a client, including soliciting a sexual relationship, making sexual advances, or engaging in verbal or physical sexual conduct.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: engaging in sexual misconduct, including: (a) engaging in or soliciting a sexual relationship with a client; (b) making a sexual advance, requesting a sexual favor, or engaging in physical contact of a sexual nature with a client; and (c) engaging in verbal or physical conduct of a sexual nature in the presence of a client

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abandoning or neglecting a client in need of immediate professional care without making reasonable arrangements for continuation of care.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: abandoning or neglecting a client in need of immediate professional care without making reasonable arrangements for the continuation of care

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining a license by means of fraud, misrepresentation, or concealment of a material fact.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: obtaining a license under this chapter by means of fraud, misrepresentation, or concealment of a material fact

definition_quote.value: the therapeutic use of everyday life activities with an individual that has or is at risk of developing an illness, injury, disease, disorder, condition, impairment, disability, activity limitation, or participation restriction; and to develop or restore the individual's ability to engage in everyday life activities by addressing physical, cognitive, psychosocial, sensory, or other aspects of the individual's performance.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of occupational therapy" means the therapeutic use of everyday life activities with an individual: (i) that has or is at risk of developing an illness, injury, disease, disorder, condition, impairment, disability, activity limitation, or participation restriction; and (ii) to develop or restore the individual's ability to engage in everyday life activities by addressing physical, cognitive, psychosocial, sensory, or other aspects of the individual's performance.

value: establishing, remediating, or restoring an undeveloped or impaired skill or ability
modifying or adapting an activity or environment
evaluating factors affecting activities of daily living
providing interventions and procedures to promote safety and performance
applying physical agent modalities, managing wound care, and using manual therapy techniques
methods_authorized.quote: "Practice of occupational therapy" includes: (i) establishing, remediating, or restoring an undeveloped or impaired skill or ability of an individual; (ii) modifying or adapting an activity or environment to enhance an individual's performance; ... (L) applying physical agent modalities, managing wound care, dry needling, and using manual therapy techniques to enhance an individual's performance skills

license_tiers.quote: The division shall issue to a person who qualifies under this chapter a license in the classification of: (a) occupational therapist; or (b) occupational therapy assistant.

mental_health_therapy_excluded.quote: Nothing in this chapter shall permit an individual licensed under this chapter to engage in the practice of mental health therapy.

individual_treatment_plan_required.quote: "Individual treatment plan" means a written record composed for each client by a person licensed under this chapter to engage in the practice of occupational therapy.

value: may not write an individual treatment plan
may not approve or cosign modifications to an individual treatment plan
may contribute to and maintain an individual treatment plan
assistant_treatment_plan_restrictions.quote: An occupational therapy assistant: (b) may not write an individual treatment plan; (c) may not approve or cosign modifications to an individual treatment plan; and (d) may contribute to and maintain an individual treatment plan.
assistant_treatment_plan_restrictions.citation: Section 305 - Limitation upon occupational therapy services

approximate.matched_normalized: may not write an individual treatment plan may not approve or cosign modifications to an individual treatment plan and may contribute to and maintain an individual treatment plan

value: may not write, modify, contribute, or maintain an individual treatment plan
aide_treatment_plan_restrictions.quote: An occupational therapy aide: (b) may not write, modify, contribute, or maintain an individual treatment plan
aide_treatment_plan_restrictions.citation: Section 305 - Limitation upon occupational therapy services

approximate.matched_normalized: may not write modify contribute or maintain an individual treatment plan

supervisor_client_contact_frequency.value: at least once each month; if interval of client care occurs one time per month or less, at least once every four visits
supervisor_client_contact_frequency.quote: meet with each client who has been referred to a supervised occupational therapy assistant at least once each month, to further assess the patient, evaluate the treatment, and modify the individual's treatment plan, except that if the interval of client care occurs one time per month or less, the occupational therapist shall meet with the client at least once every four visits

supervisor_assistant_contact_frequency.value: at least once every two weeks in person or by video conference, and at least one time every month in person
supervisor_assistant_contact_frequency.quote: meet face to face with the supervised occupational therapy assistant as often as necessary but at least once every two weeks in person or by video conference, and at least one time every month in person

max_assistants_per_supervisor.value: no more than two full-time occupational therapy assistants at one time, or four part-time occupational therapy assistants if the combined work hours do not exceed 40 hours per week
max_assistants_per_supervisor.quote: supervise no more than two full-time occupational therapy assistants at one time, or four part-time occupational therapy assistants if the combined work hours of the assistants do not exceed 40 hours per week, unless otherwise approved by the division in collaboration with the board

aide_supervision_level.quote: An occupational therapy aide: (a) may only perform occupational therapy services under the direct supervision of an occupational therapist or an occupational therapy assistant
aide_supervision_level.citation: Section 305 - Limitation upon occupational therapy services

fieldwork_weeks_ot.quote: if applying for licensure on or after July 1, 2015, complete a minimum of 24 weeks of supervised fieldwork experience

fieldwork_weeks_ota.quote: if applying for licensure on or after July 1, 2015, complete a minimum of 16 weeks of supervised fieldwork experience

dry_needling_authorized.quote: An occupational therapist may practice trigger point dry needling if the occupational therapist: (a) has a valid license to practice occupational therapy under this chapter
dry_needling_authorized.citation: Section 307 - Trigger point dry needling -- Experience requi

dry_needling_registration_required.quote: registers with the division as a trigger point dry needling practitioner
dry_needling_registration_required.citation: Section 307 - Trigger point dry needling -- Experience requi

dry_needling_course_hours.quote: at least 304 total course hours, including a minimum of: (A) 54 hours of in-person instruction; and (B) 250 supervised patient treatment hours
dry_needling_course_hours.citation: Section 307 - Trigger point dry needling -- Experience requi

physical_agent_modalities_authorized.quote: applying physical agent modalities, managing wound care, and using manual therapy techniques to enhance an individual's performance skills, if the occupational therapist has received the necessary training as determined by division rule in collaboration with the board

referral_required.quote: An occupational therapist may evaluate, initiate, and provide occupational therapy treatment for a client without a referral from another health service provider.
referral_required.citation: Section 308 - No referral required for occupational therapy.

interstate_compact_member.quote: if the applicant is applying to participate in the Occupational Therapy Licensure Compact under Chapter 42b, Occupational Therapy Licensure Compact

telehealth_authorized.quote: "Telehealth" means the application of telecommunication technology to deliver Occupational Therapy services for assessment, intervention and/or consultation.

jurisprudence_exam_required.quote: Meet any Jurisprudence Requirements established by the Remote State(s) in which the Licensee is seeking a Compact Privilege

criminal_background_check_required.quote: consent to, and complete, a criminal background check, described in Section 58-1-301.5
